notes: Per-session approval policy: GET/PUT /sessions/{id}/approval-policy exposes DSH ask/never; Ask allows approval requests, Never auto-rejects approval-requiring actions for unattended runs. The session long-press sheet gains an Approval policy dialog with a second confirmation for Never; cold sessions are read from the durable policy log and are never activated, writes need a live session. Fake-host policy fixtures/tests (8) in CI.
